summary: Iteration 2 covers 3 reported bugs + 2 new features (Google Sign-In, encrypted attachments). Backend: 28/28 pytest cases passing including all new endpoints. Frontend: all new UI elements present and functional; Auto-lock 'Immediately' now works, attachment buttons render on entry screen, Google button visible on auth screen. Biometric toggle wired to code with Alert.alert path — verified via code review (browser Alert not asserted via automation).

minor.issue: After soft-delete (deleted:true), download still returns the blob (no deleted-flag filter in find_one). Consider filtering {deleted: {$ne: true}} for privacy correctness.
Calling delete twice returns 200 both times (idempotent) — matched_count > 0 even when already deleted. Acceptable but consider distinguishing already-deleted.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert('Biometrics unavailable') fires on browser preview per source code, but react-native-web renders it as an in-DOM overlay that Playwright's page.on('dialog') doesn't capture — verified by code inspection only. Manual/device test recommended.

action_items: (Optional) Filter deleted files in GET /api/files/{file_id} to ensure soft-deleted media cannot be re-downloaded.
Recommend E1 manually smoke-test the biometric toggle on an actual iOS/Android device (browser cannot verify Expo LocalAuthentication path).
critical_code_review_comments: Google OAuth exchange properly rejects invalid session_ids (401) and creates user with 'u_'-prefixed id when new — consistent with regression contract.
PUT /api/user/kdf-salt correctly returns 409 when master password already established.
Files upload/download/delete flow works end-to-end with correct auth guard and 25MB size cap enforced server-side.
server.py is 431 lines — under the 700-line threshold; all endpoints validate via Pydantic bodies; _id excluded from responses.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for verifiable flows (Google button, Auto-lock Immediately, attachment buttons); biometric verified via code review

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test users created per test run using random emails prefixed 'test_' — no persistent seed data required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has 28 pytest cases across auth, vault, sessions, salt, google-session, kdf-salt, files, user-id-format. Reuse and extend. Frontend testIDs of interest: auth-google, tab-signup, auth-email, auth-account-password, auth-master, auth-master-confirm, auth-submit, settings-biometric, settings-autolock, autolock-0..autolock-30, add-entry-fab, att-add-image, att-add-video. Entry screen accessible at /entry/new (modal). Biometric Alert cannot be asserted via Playwright dialog listener on web preview.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 1 bugs root causes (confirmed fixed in iteration 2): (1) Biometric toggle silent — original handler didn't Alert when hasHardware=false in web preview; now Alert.alert path added in settings.tsx L43. (2) Auto-lock Immediately silent — the '0' option's onPress previously coerced 0 as falsy and skipped setAutolock; verified fixed by row showing 'Immediately' after selection. (3) Google Sign-In added — auth screen shows 'Continue with Google' (testID auth-google) and backend /api/auth/google/session correctly rejects invalid sessions with 401. (4) Attachments added — entry/[id].tsx renders 'Encrypted attachments' section with Add image / Add video pressables, backend /api/files endpoints upload/download/delete verified end-to-end.
